retrievalProfile.description: A 1960s-style album cover featuring a central portrait partially obscured by tall, wild grass with heavy, 3D-extruded display typography on the left.
triggerTerms: vintage album cover with tall grass

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a man standing with arms crossed in a field of tall, unkempt green grass that reaches his waist. The background shows a weathered wooden structure. The left side is dominated by a vertical stack of bold, white, 3D-extruded text that appears to be physically integrated into the scene's depth.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject partially submerged in foreground vegetation
Heavy typographic block balancing the subject's off-center position
Naturalistic, earthy color palette contrasted by stark white text
Low-angle perspective emphasizing the height of the grass
coreInvariants: Tall, wild green grass in the foreground
Natural outdoor lighting with soft shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The male subject is positioned slightly right of center, scaled to a medium-long shot.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The massive, white extruded title block on the upper left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the heavy text on the left, across the subject's face, and down into the texture of the grass.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper right quadrant provides breathing room with dark, out-of-focus foliage and sky.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted blue (subject's shirt) and warm tan (skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white text and the dark, desaturated background tones.

letterConstructionRules: Hard-edged 3D extrusion extending to the right and slightly down
Flat white faces with dark grey or black extrusion sides
Stacked vertical alignment with varying line lengths
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are sheared or angled to fit the 3D perspective
The 'W' and 'A' in the bottom line are tightly interlocked
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy 3D display face paired with a clean, legible secondary sans-serif for track listings.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and verticality for the 3D effect.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a man in a blue shirt standing in a field of waist-high, wild green grass in front of a dark wooden shed. Use a 1960s film aesthetic with soft grain and natural lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in the upper left using a heavy, white, 3D-extruded sans-serif font. Mask the bottom of the letters so they appear to sit behind the foreground blades of grass. Add a list of secondary text in the bottom left in a smaller, flat white sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the grass partially obscuring the bottom of the text and the subject?
Is the color palette dominated by organic greens and browns?
Does the image have a square aspect ratio?

mustRedesign: Avoid modern digital sharpness; maintain a soft film look
Ensure the 3D text feels like a physical object in the space

mustAchieve: Convincing integration of text and environment

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text extrusion direction is consistent.
Verify that the subject's expression is serious/contemplative.
Ensure the grass texture is detailed and varied.
Confirm the white text is legible against the background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a naturalistic outdoor portrait + add massive 3D-extruded display type + mask typography behind foreground elements = Vintage Album Aesthetic.
